page.layout: One title page, one column of centred lines; a woodcut vignette in the middle with a library stamp at its left (not transcribed); no margin notes.

main_text.l: C O M P E N D I U M
D O G M A T I C U M;
Scripturarias, in Controversiis vera sententia passim
Usus autem Practici suis locis etiam adscribuntur.
A N D R E A E S S E N I O,
SS. Literarum in Eccles. & Acad Ultr. Doctore.

page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows two allegorical figures with a banner reading "VIVITURIN G" and a sheaf of wheat; a library oval stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZ ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE" sits at the left and is not transcribed. The date reads MDCLXXXV in old numeral form; "Lxxxv" is transcribed as printed, with the final V partly worn. Some letters in the red title lines are faint.
